AC-0138 — leaves-always-black-regression

Status: DONE — fixed, all gates green. 2026-08-29, seed 44, engine 4.7.1, R=1-2 renders.

1. Root cause — candidate 4: AC-0128 atlas tint bake applied 3× to the shared leaf tile

The user-visible bug is not the lighting, the vColor repack, the shader L-line, or face-shade — the leaf probe proves all of those correct on the rendered vertex (vcolor [1.0, 0.0, 0.8], u_day_cut 1.0, L_day = 1.0). The defect is in the atlas pixels themselves.

Data._bake_atlas_tints() (added by AC-0128) multiplies tile pixels by the block tint once per face. Blocks 7 (Leaves) and 5 (Water) share one 32×32 rect across top/side/bottom in blocks_atlas.json ((320,0) / (224,0)), so the same pixels were multiplied by TINT_LEAVES (60,140,48) three times:

raw (119,117,119)  → bake 1 (28,64,22)  → bake 2 (6,35,4)  → bake 3 (1,19,0)   ← observed at runtime
expected single bake: (28,64,22) — green channel 64/255 = 0.25; triple-baked: 19/255 = 0.074 (below 0.15 visibility floor)

Under AC-0128's unlit shaders that albedo feeds ALBEDO = texel × COLOR.b × L directly: day L = 1.0 → green 0.074×0.8 ≈ 0.06 (near-black olive); night L = 0.20 floor → 0.012 (black). Grass (id 1) has distinct top/side/bottom rects → baked once → unaffected — exactly matching the user report (trunks/grass lit, leaves black day and night).

Verified at runtime: imported .ctex leaf tile is clean (119,117,119) (standalone pre-bake dump); the baked Data.atlas_tex and the shader's own tex uniform both showed (1,19,0) pre-fix. The triple-bake arithmetic reproduces the observed bytes exactly (truncation-included).

Secondary finding (same bug, same fix): water (id 5) is triple-baked too — its tile was darkened ~3× as well. Fixed by the same rect-dedup; water now bakes once.

2. Fix

Files changed:

FileChange
godot/autoload/data.gdTHE FIX — _bake_atlas_tints(): baked = {} rect-dedup set; if rc.x < 0 or baked.has(rc): continue + baked[rc] = true (≈4 lines + comment). Each unique tile rect is tinted exactly once.
godot/scenes/main.gdProbe only — new AWECRAFT_LOGIC=leaves arm _leaves_test() + _leaves_tile_center() helper (env-gated, headless, deterministic). Picks an exposed top-layer leaf cell, reads the ACTUAL built-mesh vertex (vColor + UV) from the chunk_lit_cutout.gdshader surface, samples the cutout material's own texture at that UV, computes L_day/L_night from the frozen AC-0135 formula, plus a whole-mesh leaf-texel scan. No game-logic change.

NOT applied (planned B2 lighting fix rejected on evidence): leaf cells do have eff = 0 (leaves close the sky column; port semantics, MC-correct for cutout leaves) — but face light samples the opposite cell (3×3 tangent patch), so exposed leaf faces get s = 1.0 regardless. The probe's vcolor [1.0, 0.0, 0.8] / L_day 1.0 pre-fix proves lighting was never the cause. No lighting.gd change → the eff array is byte-identical (battery + genhash confirm).

Fences held: AC-0135 L-line L = 0.20 + 0.80 * max(u_day * COLOR.r, COLOR.g); and AC-0136 : filter_nearest hints byte-verbatim; no shader changes; no TASKS.yaml/git/builds/docs.

6. Deviations & notes

  • Root-cause redirection: spec candidate 3 (lighting occluder) investigated first and disproved with runtime evidence (vColor/L/u_day all correct on the rendered leaf vertex); actual cause = candidate 4 (atlas tint bake), with candidate 1-2/5 ruled out statically earlier. The planned lighting.gd B2 fix was therefore NOT applied — leaving it would have changed eff values for zero benefit.
  • Same defect in water (id 5) fixed as a side effect of the identical rect-dedup (single root cause; no extra code).
  • Probe sentinel bug (in-run, probe-only): cell.x < 0 "not found" sentinel misfired for legitimately negative-x cells → switched to the pick flag; plus String(Image.Format) parse error → str(int(...)); Image.is_srgb() absent in 4.7.1 → dropped. No game code affected.
  • Known PRE-EXISTING transient: threadgen_handoff Nil→PackedByteArray (world.gd, AC-0137 class) appeared in a few runs (player battery ×3, day render ×6) — never in the G0 quit run, never in battery RESULT values; documented per spec, not a failure.
  • Render camera: spec said R=1 "tree in-frame"; the default player view doesn't frame tree (11,1), so the sanctioned AWECRAFT_AIM deterministic override (AC-0035 mechanism) was used for both shots — same camera both frames, R=1 held.
  • Scratch logs + pre-bake atlas dump script: .scratch/AC-0138/; extra *_placed.png second-frame shots kept alongside.
